    END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows

    ) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
    SELECT 1 AS num_rows
) denominator
;

		/*violatedRowsEnd*/
	) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
	SELECT 
		COUNT(*) AS num_rows
	FROM main.person cdmTable
) denominator
;
